name: toybox-crm
description: Deterministic inverses (class R) for the sagaz-toybox CRM. Comms and bank tools are excluded on purpose — see the pack section of packages/toybox/README.md for why each one is C or I, not R.

entries.note: The result carries the new contact's id; deleting that id is the exact inverse. No capture needed.
The whole contact is captured before the row dies, and the inverse restores identity, not just content: create_contact accepts the original id (restore semantics).
Updating back to the captured pre-state undoes any subset of fields; company: null (no company) is expressible on purpose.
